notablePrerequisites: Myr Galvanizer and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{R}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Myr Galvanizer with haste.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Cursed Mirror by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
